Nadia (finance): Quick thread to capture owners/ETAs from the metering postmortem. Need: credits, reissued invoices, reconciliation CSV, and prevention steps. Reply with owner + ETA.
Jules (billing-eng): I can own the backfill and reconciliation CSV. Dry-run by 2025-04-08 COB, full run 2025-04-09 AM. Will include run_id in CSV.
Cam (customer-success): I'll compile P0/P1 list and draft comms. ETA draft 2025-04-07 EOD. Will flag any sensitive enterprise accounts.
Rene (eng-ml): I'll take prevention: alert rule + schedule RCA with infra. Alert live by 2025-04-06. RCA meeting week of 2025-04-13. Noted recurring worker restarts every ~6w.
MeteringBot: [incident][MTR-4517] delayed-ingest detected 2025-03-10T03:13:22Z. auto-tag: metering/delay
Nadia (finance): Jules please make CSV: account_id, affected_window, credit_amount, invoice_action, run_id. Accounting needs that for ledger & credit memos.
Jules (billing-eng): Will do. Also adding a small validation harness sampling top-12 accounts by MRR for manual check.
Cam (customer-success): P0 list uploaded: https://internal.redwood/cs/p0_metering_apr2025.xlsx. I'll notify P0s after credits post. Include SLA: credits/reissue 3-5 business days after remediation.
Rene (eng-ml): Alert rule snippet for runbook: if ingest_lag_seconds > 300 && buffered_tokens > 1500 -> create ticket + page oncall. I'll paste rule and dashboards to the ticket.
Nadia (finance): Timeline recap: dry-run 2025-04-08, full run 2025-04-09, comms 2025-04-07, alert 2025-04-06, RCA week of 2025-04-13. Target close for all items: 2025-04-17.
Jules (billing-eng): Starting dev dry-run now. run_id=backfill-20250407-01. Posting logs to BILL-4517.
MeteringBot: [job] scheduled backfill-20250407-01 on billing-cluster-9
Cam (customer-success): If any amounts need manual review before notification, ping me. I'll coordinate CS reps.
Jules (billing-eng): dry-run snippet: ```
processed_sample: 720 accounts
potential_credits_tokens: 1,644,210

checksum: f7a9c3d2
```
Rene (eng-ml): Noting recurrence: infra reported similar restart two months ago on the same worker group. Adding to RCA agenda.
Nadia (finance): I'll create a concise action tracker and weekly check-ins until close. Meeting invite for Mon 9am PT. Add blockers here.
Jules (billing-eng): will update this thread and BILL ticket with status and final CSV after full run. :thumbsup:
